lexical.anchor: Can the architecture distinguish truth, belief, knowledge, determination, and decision? We should construct one proposition and deliberately let it move through all states: Unknown → Observed → Believed → Supported → Determined → Decided → Refuted → Corrected. Then we ask: What exactly changes at each transition, and what must remain invariant? This will allow us to derive the formal epistemic state machine and potentially identify the actual KnowledgeOS Aggregate Root / bounded-context boundaries rather than guessing them from software structure.
